trecho.2: Far from considering that Wagner Barja’s poetics falls outside visual poetry, a large part of his works must be inscribed within its coordinates of expanded seeing. Above all those in which nomenclature forms part of the work: his naming plays a determinant role, in a triangle of verbal, conceptual and visual powers. There are several works, then, that come to function with the verbal-visual element activated, generating a plural field of aesthetic forces in which even the territory of sensoriality is produced by conceptual and reflexive contiguity. Thus the set of Da², H2O Monet, Fike and even Natureza X Cultura = Barbárie draws near. In them, the submerged conversation that is established and aims at a certain infinitude, in a writing (“this insane game of writing”, as Blanchot would say), which here also bets on a simultaneity of language. The very idea of “Obranome”, (motive of curatorship and work), lies in that non-reductionist frequency.
